correctness.rationale: The source's dimension-two projective multiplicity model is used exactly. Hermitian Cauchy--Binet gives \(\det(G\overline G^T)=\sum_{i<j}m_im_j\pmod2=\binom t2\pmod2\), where \(t\) is the number of odd multiplicities. Thus LCD means \(t=2\) at even length and \(t=3\) at odd length. The parity-flipping update is nonnegative, changes the total by exactly one, is equivariant under every projective-class permutation, and is involutive across the two parities. The output cannot have minimum distance one because that would force parity weight one. Exact orbit enumeration through even length \(20\) independently reproduces the bijection.
